subject.title: feat(channels): status line on in-flight progress drafts

question: Should the new progress-draft status line be enabled by default for existing users of every supported channel, or should it remain opt-in until all supported compositor channels implement it?
rationale: This is a user-visible default and a shared plugin-facing configuration/API surface; tests cannot determine the intended upgrade and cross-channel product contract.

options.title: Approve shared default rollout
options.body: Wire all supported compositor channels, document the upgrade-visible behavior, and keep `activity` as the default.

options.title: Preserve existing output by default
options.body: Default the new setting to `off` and let users opt in per channel after the supported renderers are wired.

options.title: Narrow to Telegram
options.body: Make the setting and documentation Telegram-specific until a shared multi-channel implementation is intentionally approved.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing output by default
recommendation.body: Default the new setting to `off` and let users opt in per channel after the supported renderers are wired.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the linked design discussion and the current implementation, so they are the best available routing candidate for the intended rollout boundary.
